ValidationRule.description: Checks every quote line when the quote moves out of Draft: Quantity must be 1 and Number of Users must be filled in and 1 or more. Line-level rules don't apply while the quote is Draft, so reps never see a validation error while they work in Browse Catalogs.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Draft")), OR( Lines_Missing_Users__c > 0, Lines_Invalid_Users__c > 0, Lines_Wrong_Quantity__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving the quote out of Draft, every line needs Quantity 1 and Number of Users of 1 or more. Check the Lines Wrong Quantity, Lines Missing Users and Lines Invalid Users fields.
